title: Receiving of Commodity from Suppliers
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure) steps 4.1-4.17 and Section 6 (Contingencies) of SOP-02-A, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 98-106 = PDF pages 104-112). Step text is the Key Step column verbatim, with long bulleted detail lists summarised to their lead line. Built under docs/annotation-codebook.md. The post-acceptance documentation steps 4.10 and 4.13 hang off acceptance (4.6), not off the IAR step, since neither consumes the IAR (R3); 4.11 and 4.12 chain because each consumes the record the previous one produces (E2). Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Coordinate with Supply Officer and Inspection Committee to confirm availability of inspectors during the specified receiving schedule
Receive delivery documents after security check

Check the completeness and validity of delivery documents as follows but not limited to: PO and/or Contract, DR/SI, NTP, RSD, FDA Certificate of Analysis and/or Certificate of Product Registration (CPR), Batch Notification (for Antibiotics), Lot Release Certificates (for Vaccines), Approved Samples (for IEC Materials), Materials Safety Data Sheet (MSDS), Complete quantity of Samples needed for each batch/lot

Reject delivery according to contingency step 6.1: fill out the Non-conformance Report (Annex 3), have the delivery personnel co-sign the form, provide a copy to the delivery personnel before departure for submission to the supplier and instruct to request for a new schedule of delivery; ensure to file all fulfilled Non-conformance Reports
steps.condition: the delivery documents and samples are incomplete

steps.text: Supervise the offloading of the commodities from the delivery vehicle for inspection. Use Manual Tally Sheet as guidance on the receiving
steps.condition: the delivery documents and samples are complete

steps.text: Counter check the dimension and volume of actual carton/cases delivered versus the encoded dimension and volume stipulated in the approved RSD

Perform contingency step 6.2: inform the Office Clerk on the actual dimension and volume of cartons/cases to facilitate correction in the database if there are any; record the actual dimension and volume of cartons/cases in your inventory keeping records
steps.condition: there is a discrepancy in dimension or volume

steps.text: Inspect commodities to verify description/specifications and quantity of each product received against the Purchase Order (PO)/Contract, Delivery Receipt/Sales Invoice (DR/SI) and/or other documents related to the delivery as reference. Ensure also that delivered items are suitable to be stored at the warehouse/storeroom in accordance to its storage and temperature requirement

Perform contingency step 6.3: deliveries with damaged/expired items and unmet specifications shall be rejected outright; inform the Inspection Committee and fill out the Non-Conformance Product Report (Annex 3), have the delivery personnel co-sign the report, inform the consignor, provide a copy to the delivery personnel before departure and instruct to request for a new schedule of delivery to compensate for those rejected items and quantities
steps.condition: there are discrepancies and damages on the item

steps.text: Accept the delivery and continue offloading
steps.condition: there are no discrepancies and damages on the item

steps.text: Conduct Random Sampling (for commodities requiring FDA Test Analyses)
steps.condition: the commodities require FDA Test Analyses

steps.text: Complete and finalize information on the IAR (i.e. batch no., expiry date, etc.) for signature

Stacking of commodities: follow the Manufacturer's or supplier's direction regarding stacking (if there are any); stack cartons on pallets at least 10 cm (4 inches) off the floor with no more than 2.5 meters (8 feet) high; place liquid products on lower shelves or bottom of stacks; fragile items shall be stacked with no more than 1.5 meters (5 feet) high; stack of cartons per pallet should fit in to the standard height of rack beams; ensure that there is no reversed stacking of carton per pallet; place cling wrap/plastic wrap on top of the stack to maintain stability during storage and transport

Preparation and/or updating of Bin Cards: produce/update Bin Card for all commodities containing the following information but not limited to: complete item description based on the PO/Contract, unit of measurement, PO/Contract no., supplier, price per unit, date received, quantity, lot/batch nos., expiry date(s), location code (if applicable). Endorse to the Store Supervisor for counter checking

Location Map - Set the location where the received commodities will be placed. Update location map per pallet for all commodities inside the warehouse using the suggested template and/or Warehouse Management System. Likewise, the following segregation to different areas must be observed: Quarantine Area, Storage Area, Staging Area. Endorse Location Map to Store Helper as reference in Put-Away process

Encoding of Inbound Record and Monthly Inventory - Update Inbound Summary Report and Monthly Inventory using the suggested template and/or Warehouse Management System. Endorse all inventory stock keeping record to Store Manager for proper counter checking
Consolidate all delivery documents and send to Office Clerk for the preparation and submission of Notice of Delivery (NOD) to COA within 24 hours from the time of delivery
Encode Request for Analysis (RFA) for FDA Samples collected for submission to FDA. Maintain FDA Test Result Status Database
steps.condition: samples were collected for FDA Test Analyses

steps.text: Counter check delivery documents, Manual Tally Sheets and Inventory Stock Keeping Records ensuring file copy for future reference
Send copy of IAR to Accounting Unit for Book-up

Oversee/supervise all activities mentioned above, ensure that tasks are efficiently performed, and counter check accuracy of all data produced by warehouse staff. Facilitate direct assistance if necessary
